v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Tecum princípium * in die virtútis tuæ, in splendóribus sanctórum, ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.
text.en: Thine shall be the dominion * in the day of thy power, amid the brightness of the saints, from the womb, before the day-star, have I begotten thee.

text.la: Redemptiónem * misit Dóminus pópulo suo: mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.
text.en: The Lord sent redemption * unto His people, He hath commanded His covenant for ever.

text.la: Exórtum est * in ténebris lumen rectis corde: miséricors, et miserátor, et iustus Dóminus.
text.en: Unto the upright there ariseth * light in the darkness; the Lord is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

text.la: Apud Dóminum * misericórdia, et copiósa apud eum redémptio.
text.en: With the Lord * there is mercy, and with Him is plenteous redemption.

text.la: De fructu * ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.
text.en: Of the fruit * of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

text.la: Stéphanus autem plenus grátia et fortitúdine, faciébat prodígia et signa magna in pópulo.
text.en: And Stephen, full of grace and fortitude, did great wonders and signs among the people.

r.la: Vidit, et introívit: beátus homo, cui cæli patébant.
r.en: He saw and entered: blessed man, to whom the heavens were opened.

text.la: Sepeliérunt Stéphanum * viri timoráti, et fecérunt planctum magnum super eum.
text.en: Devout men buried Stephen * And made great mourning over him.

text.la: Da nobis, quǽsumus, Dómine, imitári quod cólimus: ut discámus et inimícos dilígere; quia eius natalícia celebrámus, qui novit étiam pro persecutóribus exoráre Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum:
text.en: Grant us, we beseech thee, O Lord, so to imitate what we revere, that we may learn to love even our enemies; for we celebrate the heavenly birthday of him who knew how to pray for his very persecutors to our Lord Jesus Christ: Who with thee liveth and reigneth, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

title.en: Sunday Within The Octave of Christmas

text.la: Dum médium siléntium tenérent ómnia, et nox in suo cursu médium iter perágeret, omnípotens Sermo tuus, Dómine, a regálibus sédibus venit, allelúia.
text.en: While all things were in quiet silence and that night was in the midst of her swift course, thine Almighty Word, O Lord, leapt down out of thy Royal Throne.

v.en: The Word was made flesh, alleluia.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, dírige actus nostros in beneplácito tuo: ut in nómine dilécti Fílii tui mereámur bonis opéribus abundáre:
text.en: O Almighty and everlasting God, do Thou order all our actions in conformity with thy good pleasure, that through the name of thy well-beloved Son, we may worthily abound in all good works. Who with thee liveth and reigneth, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
